Manage the credential-injecting proxy (issue #411)

Usage: coop proxy <COMMAND>

Commands:
  setup   Store a provider credential in a secret backend and wire it into `[proxy.<provider>]` (the default) or a per-VM override. Anthropic (Claude) is the default provider; pass `--openai` for Codex
  status  Show what each VM's agents resolve to (per-VM override → default → off), with credentials redacted
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
